utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm in! What time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let's meet at my place at 9 AM on Saturday. I'll have coffee ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Hana, what time does the repair drive start tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think it starts at 9 AM, but let me double-check the sign-up sheet to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, just let me know once you confirm.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Noah, I've been inventorying the spare parts we have. What do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Um, repair drive? I think I need some screws... or maybe bolts? Let me check my list... actually, I might have left it at home.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, I've got a good mental list. What size are you thinking? I can check my stash.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, I heard you've been helping out with the repair drive. How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, it's going, but I'm a bit worried about getting all the parts organized in time. We need a proper schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe I can help sort the parts if you make a list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, has the repair drive actually fixed anything for you yet, or is it still just making that weird clicking noise?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Honestly, I haven't really noticed much difference—still clicks like crazy. Have you heard if anyone else had better luck?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No, just more noise complaints from Mrs. Chen next door. You think we should ask the super to take a look at it instead?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? They're collecting tools and spare parts for folks who need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard! I was actually gonna bring over my spare wrenches and that old drill I fixed up last month.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh that's wonderful, Gus! I bet Mr. Henderson at the auto shop is gonna be thrilled — his toolbox was cleaned out last storm.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive? I'm helping to spread the word—everyone's invited to pitch in this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh yes, I heard about it! I was just checking my calendar to make sure I don't double-book. Is it still at the old community center on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's the one! I'll be there early to set up; hope you can make it—it'll be great to have your help!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Kira, I heard you're organizing the neighborhood repair drive—need a hand with anything this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure you're up for it, Sam? It's a lot of work.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'm happy to help with whatever's needed—organizing tools, fixing things, or just making coffee for the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, I'm glad you're here to talk about the repair drive. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, I'm a bit short on time—what's the main thing you need from me for this repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I just need you to confirm if you can cover the east side of the block for tool pickup on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Eli, are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? I heard it's going to be a big event.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll be there, Vik. I like to know what I'm getting into — what time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It starts at 10 AM sharp, but I heard they'll have coffee and donuts for early birds.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Uli! Good to see you. What's this about a repair drive again? I swear I had it written down somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's... a way to help fix things around the neighborhood. I thought maybe you'd have some spare time for it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Spare time? Well, I've got plenty of that, though I might forget what I'm supposed to be fixing halfway through!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I think it's a great chance for us to get to know each other better while helping out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard a little about it from Mrs. Chen at the grocery store. Sounds like a good way to finally meet some folks around here.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, exactly! I'm planning to bring some cookies to share. Want to join me at the sign-up table later?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I'm spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh hey Quinn, I just got here—what's a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's where everyone brings broken stuff—lamps, chairs, toasters—and we fix them together! I'm rounding up folks for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I've got an old lamp and a toaster that need fixing. I'll bring them by around 10, right when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good. I'll keep an eye out for you in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I was thinking we should coordinate the repair drive with the school pickup times so more parents can participate.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's a great idea, Faye. I'll talk to the school office to see if we can set up a table near the pickup area.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, that way we can catch folks while they're already waiting for their kids.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I heard you're organizing a repair drive for the community center. How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yeah, it's coming together! I'm planning to gather tools and volunteers for this Saturday morning. Are you free to help out?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'd love to help! Just tell me what time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, I heard about the repair drive—want me to bring over my tool kit and see what we can fix up?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's kind of you, Gus. But do you have time? I'd hate for it to interfere with your afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Don't worry about that, Pia—my afternoon's wide open, and I'd rather be tinkering than twiddling my thumbs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Have you seen the repair drive? I thought it was supposed to be parked near the old oak tree.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I noticed it's a bit further down the street today. Maybe they moved it for more space?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, that makes sense. I'll check closer to the corner then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Well, I think it's for fixing up the old community center's heating system. Did you hear something different?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, who's organizing the drive, and do we need to bring our own tools?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Cleo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with that?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, I could use some help sorting through the donated supplies. Can you come by tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'll be there. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Noah, I heard something about a repair drive going on—what's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: A repair drive? Hmm, I think I might have missed something. What's that for?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I thought you'd know more about it—I just heard someone mention it's for fixing up things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, Tess, are you sure this repair drive is going to fix the issue, or is it just another quick fix?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh honey, if there's one thing I've learned from fixing up my old station wagon, it's that a proper repair drive is better than any quick patch—you just have to take the long way around the potholes!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're saying this drive actually does the trick? I've been burned by too many so-called fixes to just take your word for it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Uli, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help spreading the word while I'm out and about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's kind of you, Ira. A few flyers would be nice, if you don't mind.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, I can grab some from you now and put them up at the grocery store and the library.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Leo! I was just thinking about that repair drive—what day is it again? I wrote it down somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday, the 14th.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday the 14th, right! I knew it was soon, but I couldn't remember if it was this weekend or next.
